content.short: DeFi Development Corp, a Nasdaq-listed company with a SOL treasury, issues dfdvSOL so anyone can stake SOL with it and stay liquid.
content.description: DeFi Development Corp was the first US public company to adopt a Solana treasury strategy. Its liquid staking token, dfdvSOL, lets anyone stake SOL with the company's validators through Sanctum and keep a tradeable position. The token earns staking rewards and is accepted as collateral on Jupiter Lend with a high loan-to-value ratio. The company also offers CHAD, a listed security that pays a daily dividend, and it reports its SOL per share so investors can follow the treasury.
content.meta: Stake SOL with Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp and hold dfdvSOL, usable as DeFi collateral. Explore DFDV Staked SOL on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
